report.title: Phase 2 Task 12: Automated Error Detection and Alerting

task_details.name: Implement automated error detection and alerting
key_features: 8 Alert Types: Error Spike, Error Pattern, Performance Degradation, System Failure, Security Incident, Threshold Breach, Anomaly Detection, Correlation Alert
5 Priority Levels: Low, Medium, High, Critical, Emergency with automatic escalation
4 Alert Statuses: Active, Acknowledged, Resolved, Suppressed for complete lifecycle
6 Notification Channels: Console, Email, Slack, SMS, Webhook, Choreo Logs
Rule-based Detection: Configurable conditions for errors, performance metrics, patterns
Automatic Anomaly Detection: Intelligent pattern recognition for unusual behavior
Correlation Integration: Full integration with correlation ID system
Alert Deduplication: Cooldown periods to prevent alert spam
Impact Assessment: Automatic estimation of affected users and downtime
Action Recommendations: Immediate, investigation, and resolution steps

extreme_debugging_capabilities_added: Real-time automated error detection with intelligent alerting
Multi-level priority system for critical issue escalation
Pattern-based anomaly detection for proactive monitoring
Correlation-aware alerting for related issue tracking
Comprehensive action recommendations for faster resolution
Multi-channel notification system for team coordination
Alert deduplication to prevent notification fatigue
Impact assessment for prioritizing critical issues

integration_points.integration: Automatic processing of classified errors through detection rules
Real-time monitoring of performance metrics with threshold alerting
Correlation ID propagation in all alerts for request tracing
All alerts flow through streaming system for real-time visibility

alert_workflow.detection: Real-time rule evaluation on errors and metrics
alert_workflow.tracking: Complete lifecycle management with status updates

integration_steps: Initialize automated error detection in application startup
Configure detection rules for production environment
Set up notification channels (Slack, email, etc.)
Test alert generation with simulated scenarios
Configure alert acknowledgment and resolution workflows
testing_recommendations: Test error spike detection with controlled error generation
Validate performance threshold alerting under load
Verify correlation ID propagation in alert scenarios
Test alert cooldown and deduplication mechanisms

quality_assessment.performance_impact: Minimal overhead with efficient rule evaluation
quality_assessment.reliability: Robust error handling with fallback mechanisms
quality_assessment.maintainability: Modular design with easy rule configuration

choreo_deployment_benefits: Security incident detection for production environments

immediate: Integrate automated detection into existing error handlers
Set up notification channels for team alerts
long_term: Move to Phase 3 real-time monitoring dashboard
